property.name: Availability Topic
property.description: Topic to subscribe for device availability (optional)

property.name: Availability Topic Value
property.description: Raw value received from the availability topic

property.name: Availability Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to extract availability value (e.g., "$.status"). Leave empty to use raw payload.

property.name: Availability Value Path Result
property.description: Result of JSONPath extraction for availability

property.name: Availability Status
property.description: Current availability status

property.name: Payload Available
property.description: Payload that indicates device is available (if only this is set, other values mean unavailable)

property.name: Payload Not Available
property.description: Payload that indicates device is not available (if only this is set, other values mean available)

property.name: Capabilities
property.description: Abilities this light has, derived from the topics (or JSON keys) that are filled in

property.name: Light State
property.description: Current state as reported to Control4

property.name: Payload Mode
property.description: Separate Topics: one topic per ability with plain values (Tasmota, ESPHome). JSON: one state topic and one command topic carrying a JSON object (Zigbee2MQTT, Home Assistant JSON schema).

property.name: JSON State Topic
property.description: Topic the light publishes its JSON state on (e.g. zigbee2mqtt/kitchen)

property.name: JSON Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish JSON commands to (e.g. zigbee2mqtt/kitchen/set)

property.name: Optimistic
property.description: Report commanded state immediately instead of waiting for the device (Auto: yes when no state topic is set)

property.name: QoS
property.description: MQTT Quality of Service level for subscriptions and commands

property.name: Retain
property.description: Retain command messages on the broker

property.name: Power State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting on/off state (e.g. stat/tasmota_light/POWER)

property.name: Power Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the on/off value when the payload is JSON (e.g. "$.POWER"). Leave empty to use the raw payload.

property.name: Power Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish on/off commands to (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_light/POWER)

property.name: State Key
property.description: JSON key (or JSONPath) holding the on/off state

property.name: State On
property.description: Value that means ON (if only this is set, other values mean OFF)

property.name: State Off
property.description: Value that means OFF (if only this is set, other values mean ON)

property.name: Payload On
property.description: Value to send to turn the light on

property.name: Payload Off
property.description: Value to send to turn the light off

property.name: Brightness State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting brightness. Filling in a brightness topic makes the light a dimmer.

property.name: Brightness Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the brightness value (e.g. "$.Dimmer" for Tasmota stat/x/RESULT)

property.name: Brightness Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish brightness commands to (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_light/Dimmer)

property.name: Brightness Key
property.description: JSON key for brightness (e.g. "brightness"). Filling it in makes the light a dimmer.

property.name: Brightness Scale Max
property.description: Device value for 100% brightness (100 for Tasmota, 254 for Zigbee2MQTT, 255 for many others)

property.name: Color Temp State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting color temperature. Filling in a color temperature topic adds tunable white.

property.name: Color Temp Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the color temperature value (e.g. "$.CT")

property.name: Color Temp Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish color temperature commands to (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_light/CT)

property.name: Color Temp Key
property.description: JSON key for color temperature (e.g. "color_temp"). Filling it in adds tunable white.

property.name: Color Temp Unit
property.description: Unit the device uses for color temperature (Tasmota and Zigbee use mireds)

property.name: Color Temp Min
property.description: Warmest color temperature the light supports, in Kelvin

property.name: Color Temp Max
property.description: Coolest color temperature the light supports, in Kelvin

property.name: Color State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting color. Filling in a color topic adds full color.

property.name: Color Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the color value (e.g. "$.Color" or "$.HSBColor")

property.name: Color Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish color commands to (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_light/Color)

property.name: Color Key
property.description: JSON key for the color object (e.g. "color"). Filling it in adds full color.

property.name: Color Format
property.description: How the color value is written. Hex also accepts Tasmota's extra white channels (e.g. FF800000).

property.name: JSON Color Format
property.description: Shape of the color object sent in JSON mode

property.name: Color Includes Brightness
property.description: Yes: RGB/Hex values are scaled to the brightness (Tasmota). No: always send full-intensity color.

property.name: White State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the white channel level (RGBW lights)

property.name: White Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the white value (e.g. "$.White")

property.name: White Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish white channel commands to (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_light/White)

property.name: White Key
property.description: JSON key for the white channel (e.g. "white")

property.name: White Scale Max
property.description: Device value for 100% white

property.name: White Color Temp
property.description: Color temperature of the white channel in Kelvin, used when there is no color temperature topic

property.name: Transition Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish the fade time to before each command (e.g. cmnd/tasmota_light/Speed). Filling it in lets the device do fades itself.

property.name: Transition Key
property.description: JSON key for the fade time (e.g. "transition")

property.name: Transition Unit
property.description: Unit of the transition value. Tasmota Speed: 1-40 half-seconds (enable Fade on the device).
